note: Opens at zero over all 19 modules of odoo/tests. This tree is the test FRAMEWORK -- TransactionCase, HttpCase, Form, the Chrome CDP driver, the suite runner, the result reporter -- production code every addon test in the repository runs on, and it was in no lane of this gate. Not by judgement: _sources.is_test_path calls any path with a 'tests' component a test path, so the package was excluded by the name of its directory while the 341 genuine test files under odoo/orm/tests and the rest were excluded on purpose. py_function_length already carried its own tests lane (pyfunclen_tests) for this reason; this is that precedent applied. Verified non-vacuous: the lane scans exactly 19 files, and these gates raise rather than report zero over an empty scan.
